inputs.checklistItemText: Equipment pad installed within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle routes lacks required 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts (bollards) per AE Design equipment pad details, or bollards not spaced to allow equipment door opening
inputs.question: Are any of the transformer pads located within 4 feet of parking areas, drive aisles, or vehicle circulation routes? If yes, are bollards (protective metal posts) shown and dimensioned around those transformer pads?

output.reasoning: The agent is performing a progressive presence check—first identifying whether transformer pads exist within 4 feet of vehicle areas, then checking for bollard presence and dimensioning. This is a feature/documentation verification (presence of bollards and their dimensions on the plan), not a measurement of clearance or spacing between physical features.
